svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI INFRASTRUCTURE · HARDWARE-ALIGNED SPARSE ATTENTION (#381)
DeepSeek NSA vs. Moonshot MoBA vs. Dense FlashAttention-3 (128K–1M Context)
GQA-Aligned Block Selection + Coarse Token Compression Speeds Up 128K Prefill by 9.0x & Decode by 4.2x at 99.7% Accuracy
Why Dense O(S^2) & Token-Sparse Fail on GPUs
• Dense FlashAttention-3 still takes 11.8s TTFT at 128K (85% FLOPs)
• Unaligned per-head token sparsity causes random 128B HBM gathers
• Different heads in a GQA group selecting different KV blocks
re-multiplies Decode HBM bandwidth by 8x (destroying GQA savings!)
• MoBA: Parameter-free mean-key block router + FlashAttn Varlen (4.8x)
• NSA 3-Branch: Compressed Tokens + Selected 64-Tok Blocks + Window
• Enforces GQA Group-Shared KV Block Selection in SRAM!
4-Tier Long-Context Attention Matrix (128K Context · 70B Model · 8x H100)
Tier 1 (Dense FlashAttention-3) : 128K TTFT = 11.80s (1.0x) | Decode TPOT = 42.0ms | RULER-128K = 98.8%
Tier 2 (Sliding Window + 4 Sinks) : 128K TTFT = 1.45s (8.1x) | Decode TPOT = 8.5ms | RULER-128K = 24.5% (Fail)
Tier 3 (Moonshot MoBA Block-Sparse) : 128K TTFT = 2.45s (4.8x) | Decode TPOT = 18.5ms | RULER-128K = 99.1%
Tier 4 (DeepSeek NSA 3-Branch) : 128K TTFT = 1.31s (9.0x) | Decode TPOT = 10.0ms | RULER-128K = 99.7%
